scenes.title: The 1970 Strange Situation Playroom Separation & Reunion Test
scenes.era: 1970 developmental psychology clinic at Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore
scenes.recognition_hook: Sunlit observation playroom with two adult chairs flanking a floor playmat of colorful wooden stacking rings, a wide one-way observation mirror on the back wall, and an open clinic door as the caregiver returns

layout.room: 9-by-9-foot high-key architectural observation playroom with pale birch paneling, soft beige woven carpet, plain unbranded gallery frames, a horizontal one-way glass observation window on the upper back wall, and a solid oak clinic door on the right

positions.who: Matte-white porcelain twelve-month-old toddler mannequin in a soft sky-blue knit romper
positions.where: seated on the center floor playmat surrounded by wooden stacking rings and blocks
positions.facing: turning upward toward the right-hand clinic doorway at the sound of the latch

positions.who: Matte-white porcelain mother mannequin in a warm camel knit cardigan and tailored cream slacks
positions.where: stepping across the right doorway threshold beside the empty right-hand chair
positions.facing: kneeling forward with open porcelain arms toward the center playmat

positions.who: Matte-white porcelain stranger researcher mannequin in a slate-grey blazer and linen skirt
positions.where: standing up from the left-hand wooden armchair
positions.facing: stepping quietly toward the exit door so mother and toddler reunite alone

props.name: Wooden rainbow ring stacker and geometric building blocks
props.period_detail: 1970s smooth turned-maple spindle with painted pastel wooden rings and unpainted beechwood cubes on a woven playmat
props.physical_behavior: dropped onto the carpet during separation protest, or turned mechanically in silence during avoidant masking

props.name: Pair of 1970s wooden-arm clinic chairs and leather handbag
props.period_detail: two mid-century pale-oak armchairs angled toward the center playmat, with a structured tan leather handbag resting on the mother's chair
props.physical_behavior: the mother leaves her tan handbag on the seat as she exits, leaving a visible physical anchor in the room

props.name: Brushed-brass clinic door latch and one-way observation glass
props.period_detail: solid pale-oak clinic door with a horizontal brass lever and a wide flush acoustic observation mirror along the upper wall
props.physical_behavior: clicks shut cleanly on separation and swings inward smoothly on Episode 5 and Episode 8 reunions

actions: Caregiver sets her magazine and handbag on the oak chair, opens the clinic door, and steps out while the toddler watches the closing door
Stranger kneels near the playmat offering a wooden ring while the distressed toddler turns back toward the closed door
Caregiver swings the door open, pauses a beat, then kneels with open arms to lift and soothe the toddler
reactions: Secure toddler reaches both arms up immediately, settles chest-to-shoulder within seconds, and steps back down to stack wooden rings
Avoidant toddler keeps back turned toward the returning caregiver, leaning forward to rotate a single wooden block while internal pulse stays high

key_visual.description: Side-by-side and sequential reunion contrast inside the bright 1970 playroom: two adult oak chairs framing a center floor playmat of wooden stacking rings as the porcelain mother kneels at the open doorway
must_show: two angled oak chairs flanking a center floor toy mat
clothed matte-white porcelain toddler and mother mannequins
clinic door opening for the reunion moment

scenes.wardrobe: Toddler in soft sky-blue cotton romper; mother in warm camel knit cardigan and cream trousers; stranger in slate-grey blazer and pale blouse; observers behind glass in crisp white lab coats
scenes.lighting: High-key diffused architectural studio daylight with soft overhead skylight fill and crisp porcelain rim highlights

scenes.title: Episode 3 Unfamiliar Stranger Arrival & Three-Minute Approach

layout.room: Bright 9-by-9-foot observation playroom with left stranger chair, right caregiver chair, and center toy mat

positions.where: left oak armchair transitioning down beside the playmat
positions.facing: holding a blank cream notebook/magazine, then offering a wooden block toward the toddler

positions.where: center carpet shifting closer to mother's chair
positions.facing: glancing warily between the stranger and caregiver

props.name: Unbranded matte-cream reading folio
props.period_detail: clean text-free cream paper folio held during Minute 1 silent sitting
props.physical_behavior: folded and placed on the chair armrest before kneeling toward the playmat

actions: Stranger enters quietly, sits for sixty seconds in the left chair, exchanges brief nods with the mother, then kneels to roll a wooden toy
reactions: Toddler pauses toy play and checks the caregiver's posture as a social safety reference

scenes.title: 1993 Regensburg Cardiac Telemetry & Salivary Cortisol Discovery

layout.room: Adjacent bright observation control console overlooking the playroom through clean glass

positions.who: Porcelain developmental psychobiologist in white lab coat
positions.where: standing at a pale-birch observation console behind the window
positions.facing: inspecting an analog paper chart trace and glass saliva sample vials

props.name: Chart-paper heart trace and clear glass cortisol vials
props.period_detail: unlabelled moving paper strip showing rapid crimson-ink pulse peaks alongside racked clear glass vials
props.physical_behavior: stylus needle sweeps rapidly upward even while the avoidant toddler sits motionless on the carpet beyond the glass

actions: Researcher compares the still posture of the toddler through the observation window against the spiking crimson pulse waveform on the paper strip
reactions: Sharp visual contrast between outward stillness on the carpet and surging internal physiological stress
